title: Portfolio position signal annotation -- non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #118 (api-portfolio-position-signal), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: No test asserts that POST /api/portfolio/positions (add_position) returns signal/confidence/confidence_band as null, even though the code explicitly sets them and API.md/openapi.json document it as intentional. test_create_new_position_returns_201 (backend/tests/integration/test_portfolio_positions.py) only asserts current_price/unrealized_pnl_pct are null. Behavior is correct and documented, just untested explicitly -- add an explicit assertion (either extend the existing test or add a dedicated one).

Non-blocking, PR #118 round 2 (task/api-portfolio-position-signal): `PositionOut.signal`/`.confidence`/`.confidence_band` `Field(description=...)` in backend/app/api/schemas.py (and the identical text this generates into backend/openapi.json's components.schemas.PositionOut and frontend/src/api/types.ts's PositionOut JSDoc) still only lists two null-triggering conditions (current_price fetch failed; the weekly-history fetch failed) after commit 94691d8's fix added a third (the latest daily bar has a valid close but NaN open/high/low and so doesn't survive drop_malformed_daily_bars's strict filter). `_compute_position_signal`'s docstring and `get_portfolio`'s own route docstring both document the third condition correctly -- only the Pydantic field-level description (the actual public API contract source) is stale. docs/architecture/API.md's GET /api/portfolio section has the same gap (only two of three null conditions listed). Update both to mention all three conditions and regenerate backend/openapi.json.

review.notes: Pure documentation/contract-description change, no runtime logic touched.
